files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Using age = 2025 minus birth_year, put riders into the age groups under 25, 25-39, 40-59 and 60 or older, and count the riders in each age group for each membership type (trimmed, lower case); leave out riders without a birth year. `result` should be a table with the age groups as rows and the membership types as columns.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv, drop riders with an empty birth_year, set age = 2025 - birth_year, assign groups under 25 (age < 25), 25-39, 40-59 and 60 or older (age >= 60), normalise membership (strip, lower case), and count riders per age group (rows) and membership type (columns), 0 where none.

acceptable_variants.notes: group labels may be spelled differently; row and column order free; Where an age group and membership type combination has no riders, its count may be given as 0 or as a missing value.

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
